name: @veren/graph-node-tool
description: Use when a flow must invoke a tool already registered in the DSH tool registry (ctx.tools, e.g. bash/fs/web) as a flow node: it adapts resolved flow inputs into tool arguments, runs the call through the full tools pipeline (sandbox, policies, timeout), and projects the canonical JSON value into blackboard slots; skip it when the flow only needs the built-in noop/fail/echo/subflow fixtures of @veren/graph-flow-engine.
